[Thinking]
**Searching Eclipses Recently**

I'm focusing my search on solar eclipses that occurred in 1999, as the goal is to pinpoint the last one before the year 2000. This temporal constraint is crucial for identifying the specific date needed.
[/Thinking]

The last solar eclipse before the year 2000 occurred on **August 11, 1999**.

It was a **total solar eclipse** that was visible across a wide corridor including the Atlantic Ocean, Europe, the Middle East, and Southern Asia. It was one of the most-viewed total solar eclipses in history due to its path passing through many densely populated areas.
